risks.risk: Speaker or audio crackle not detectable from photos.
risks.proof: Short audio/video clip playing a demo song or sustained note.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the model number/label on the back or near the control panel.
Video of the keyboard powered on, playing a scale across all keys and triggering main buttons.
Photo of the included power adapter with plug and voltage markings.
Short audio clip demonstrating speaker output without crackle.
response.reason: The Yamaha brand is visible but the specific model cannot be read from either photo, and the comparable listings span a very wide price range tied to model; a model-confirming photo is required before any worst-case price can be set.
